title: banksia fraseri
intro: Banksia fraseri, commonly known as the Frosted Banksia, is a flowering plant species native to eastern Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Banksia fraseri include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, improve immune function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
